columns.name: soil_type

columns.reason: As-built electrical component spec recorded at installation.

columns.name: shading_zone

columns.name: land_lease_type

columns.name: string_age_months

columns.reason: Temperature aggregate from monitoring history available at prediction time.

columns.name: warranty_credit_usd
